company_notes: Summary: Large enterprise banking platform looking for a private, VPC-hosted IDE copilot with strict audit and retention controls. Primary drivers: reduce dev onboarding time for internal tools + improve PR review throughput while meeting regulatory requirements.

01 — Discovery call (2024-09-18): Platform engineering lead (K. Alvarez) - strong emphasis on SSO/SAML, session-level audit logs, and ability to pin model versions per team. Asked about ability to freeze model updates and route to fallback smaller models during incidents. Quote: 'We cannot have stealth upgrades that change completions overnight.'

02 — Security deep-dive (2024-10-03): InfoSec requested HSM/KMS integration diagram, retention policy enforcement, and proof of SOC2/ISO alignment. Asked for example audit log entries and retention purge controls. EXPLICIT ask: demonstrate immutable audit trail export to SIEM.

03 — Technical POC kickoff (2024-10-20): 2-week POC scoped: private control-plane in customer VPC, one dedicated GPU cluster, demo low-latency streaming to JetBrains IDE via websocket, model pinning per repo. SE (Ravi) to deliver automation scripts and latency dashboard.

04 — Mid-POC sync (2024-11-05): Latency nominal but tail spikes during concurrent batch runs. Engineering to try smaller quantized variant + KV cache warmup. Customer shared internal SLAs: 99th percentile completion latency <150ms, median <40ms for single-line completions.

05 — Procurement signals (2024-11-20): Procurement requested template SLA and rough TCO for 3-year reserved capacity. Finance asked for discount tiers and onboarding timeline (90-120 days for private deployment + compliance testing).
